caption: The worked example for N = 4: QFT|01⟩ gives the four amplitudes 1/2, i/2, −1/2, −i/2, in the order |00⟩, |01⟩, |10⟩, |11⟩. The two highlighted columns are the Fourier phases that only the controlled phase gates add — Hadamards alone would leave all four amplitudes equal to 1/2.

spec.title: QFT|01⟩ for N = 4 (j = 1, √N = 2)
spec.aria: A table with columns k = 0 to 3 for the basis states |00⟩, |01⟩, |10⟩, |11⟩, showing the phase factors 1, i, −1, −i and the resulting amplitudes 1/2, i/2, −1/2, −i/2.
